name: Mesutcydev Apps
subtitle: On-device AI tools for iPhone
description: A source for Mesutcydev's local-first iOS apps. These builds run supported AI workloads on the device and expose network access only through the app's explicit, authenticated features.

apps.name: On Device: LAS
apps.subtitle: A local AI server for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: On Device: LAS runs supported language models locally on your iPhone and exposes authenticated OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Ollama-compatible APIs over your trusted local network. It does not silently fall back to a cloud service.

versions.localizedDescription: Current sideload release with the local API server and coordinated on-device model runtime.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: On Device: LAS exposes your selected on-device language model to trusted computers on your local network.

apps.name: ForgeSign
apps.subtitle: Sign and install IPAs on-device.
apps.localizedDescription: ForgeSign is an on-device IPA re-signer for iPhone and iPad. Sign, install, and manage your own app builds locally without sending certificates or IPAs to a server.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds the Sources tab, IPA preflight, optional dylib injection, and refreshed Liquid Glass surfaces.

apps.name: MacPair for iOS
apps.subtitle: A local-first remote desktop client for Mac.
apps.localizedDescription: MacPair for iOS connects to an approved MacPair Host on your local network for screen sharing, keyboard and pointer control, clipboard sync, file transfer, audio, and optional remote-terminal access.

versions.localizedDescription: Current iOS client release. The IPA is unsigned and is intended to be re-signed by the installer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: MacPair uses your local network to discover and connect to Macs running MacPair Host.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MacPair captures your voice for on-device dictation into your approved Mac.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MacPair transcribes your voice on-device so you can dictate text into your approved Mac.

apps.name: OnDevice LLM
apps.subtitle: A local-first AI workbench for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: OnDevice LLM runs supported language, vision, voice, and image-generation workloads on your iPhone. It includes local model management, camera and voice features, retrieval tools, and an authenticated local API without silently falling back to a cloud service.

versions.localizedDescription: Sideload build with the local AI workbench, share extension, and full memory entitlements.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses the back camera to capture live video of your terminal or code editor for real-time analysis.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM can expose your on-device language model to computers on your local network when you enable the Local API Server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses the microphone for hold-to-talk dictation in the chat composer. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your phone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM can analyze code from photos in your library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses on-device speech recognition to convert your voice into text for the chat composer.

apps.name: SiteAgent
apps.subtitle: Manage websites from an AI agent on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: SiteAgent lets you connect GitHub repositories, edit websites with natural language, review visual diffs, preview changes, and commit approved updates from your iPhone. It supports cloud and on-device AI providers.

versions.localizedDescription: Current sideload-unlocked release with website editing, AI routing, previews, deployment integrations, and local-model support.

apps.name: Core AI: LAS
apps.subtitle: A Core AI model server for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Core AI: LAS runs supported Core AI language and vision models locally on iPhone and exposes the selected model through an authenticated local API. This build requires iOS 27 or newer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Core AI: LAS exposes your selected on-device Core AI model to trusted computers on your local network.
